source.text: Μὴ κρίνετε, ἵνα μὴ κριθῆτε·

records.literal_gloss: Not judge, so that not you be judged;

en.L: Do not judge, so that you may not be judged.
en.B: Stop passing judgment on others, so that you will not be judged.
en.R: Do not judge other people, and God will not judge you.

es.L: No {{plural_you:juzguen|juzguéis}}, para que no {{plural_you:sean|seáis}} juzgados.
es.B: {{plural_you:Dejen|Dejad}} de juzgar a los demás, para que no {{plural_you:sean|seáis}} juzgados.
es.R: No {{plural_you:juzguen|juzguéis}} a otras personas, y Dios no {{plural_you:los|os}} juzgará.

fr.L: Ne jugez pas, afin de ne pas être jugés.
fr.B: Cessez de juger les autres, et vous ne serez pas jugés.
fr.R: Ne jugez pas les autres, et Dieu ne vous jugera pas.

sw.L: Msihukumu, ili msihukumiwe.
sw.B: Acheni kuwahukumu wengine, ili ninyi msihukumiwe.
sw.R: Msiwahukumu watu wengine, na Mungu hatawahukumu ninyi.

vi.L: Đừng xét đoán, để các con khỏi bị xét đoán;
vi.B: Đừng lên án người khác, để chính các con khỏi bị lên án.
vi.R: Đừng xét đoán người khác, thì Đức Chúa Trời sẽ không xét đoán các con.

ko.L: 판단하지 마라, 너희가 판단받지 않도록.
ko.B: 남을 판단하는 일을 멈추어라. 그러면 너희도 판단받지 않을 것이다.
ko.R: 다른 사람을 판단하지 마라. 그러면 하나님께서도 너희를 판단하지 않으실 것이다.

decisions.choice: judge: condemn, set oneself up as judge over others
alternatives: make any moral judgment at all
decisions.reason: The verb covers both deciding and condemning. Jesus does not forbid telling right from wrong (7:6, 15-20); he forbids a harsh, fault-finding judgment of others that ignores one's own faults (7:3-5).

decisions.choice: so that you may not be judged: by God
decisions.reason: The passive points to God's judgment, as 7:2 shows.

decisions.choice: God will not judge you
decisions.reason: Readable names God, as the passive implies.

decisions.choice: plural_you spans on every plural form addressed to the listeners (juzguen|juzguéis, sean|seáis)
decisions.reason: Spanish has two plural forms of "you", Latin American "ustedes" and Peninsular "vosotros"; the setting chooses between them. English has no such choice, so these spans have no English counterpart. The same throughout the chapter.

decisions.choice: "xét đoán" (L, R); "lên án" (B) for judging
decisions.reason: The meaning decision says the word here means condemning, setting oneself up as judge. Literal keeps "xét đoán", which covers both judging and condemning; Balanced makes the sense plain with "lên án".

decisions.choice: "Đức Chúa Trời sẽ không xét đoán các con" (R)
alternatives: các con sẽ không bị xét đoán
decisions.reason: The passive points to God as the judge (meaning decision); Readable names him, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "판단하다" at every level
decisions.reason: The Greek verb means to sit in judgment on others and condemn them (meaning decision). "비판하다" now means to criticise, which is too weak, and "심판하다" belongs to God's judgment; "판단하다" in the sense of passing judgment on someone covers both halves of the saying. Literal keeps the purpose clause after the command, as the Greek has it. No deity_pronoun spans in Korean, through Matthew 7: God and Jesus are honoured with "께서" and -시-.

source.text: ἐν ᾧ γὰρ κρίματι κρίνετε κριθήσεσθε, καὶ ἐν ᾧ μέτρῳ μετρεῖτε μετρηθήσεται ὑμῖν.

records.literal_gloss: With what for judgment you judge you will be judged, and with what measure you measure it will be measured to you.

en.L: For with the judgment you judge, you will be judged, and with the measure you measure, it will be measured to you.
en.B: The way you judge others is the way you will be judged, and the measure you use for them will be used for you.
en.R: God will judge you in the same way you judge others. He will use the same rules for you that you use for them.

es.L: Porque {{plural_you:serán|seréis}} juzgados con el juicio con que {{plural_you:juzgan|juzgáis}}, y se {{plural_you:les|os}} medirá con la medida con que {{plural_you:miden|medís}}.
es.B: La forma en que {{plural_you:juzgan|juzgáis}} a los demás es la forma en que {{plural_you:serán|seréis}} juzgados, y la medida que {{plural_you:usan|usáis}} con ellos se usará con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.R: Dios {{plural_you:los|os}} juzgará de la misma manera en que {{plural_you:juzgan|juzgáis}} a los demás. Usará con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} las mismas reglas que {{plural_you:ustedes usan|vosotros usáis}} con ellos.

fr.L: Car du jugement dont vous jugez, vous serez jugés, et de la mesure dont vous mesurez, il vous sera mesuré.
fr.B: La manière dont vous jugez les autres sera celle dont vous serez jugés, et la mesure dont vous vous servez pour eux servira pour vous.
fr.R: Dieu vous jugera de la même façon que vous jugez les autres. Il utilisera pour vous les mêmes règles que celles que vous utilisez pour eux.

sw.L: Kwa maana kwa hukumu ile mnayohukumu, mtahukumiwa, na kwa kipimo kile mnachopimia, mtapimiwa.
sw.B: Jinsi mnavyowahukumu wengine ndivyo mtakavyohukumiwa, na kipimo mnachotumia kwa wengine ndicho kitakachotumiwa kwenu.
sw.R: Mungu atawahukumu ninyi kama mnavyowahukumu wengine. Atatumia kwenu kanuni zilezile mnazotumia kwao.

vi.L: vì các con xét đoán bằng sự xét đoán nào, các con sẽ bị xét đoán bằng sự xét đoán ấy; và các con đong bằng đấu nào, thì sẽ được đong lại cho các con bằng đấu ấy.
vi.B: Các con xét đoán người khác thế nào, các con cũng sẽ bị xét đoán thế ấy; các con dùng đấu nào để đong cho người khác, thì cũng sẽ bị đong lại bằng chính đấu ấy.
vi.R: Các con xét đoán người khác thế nào, Đức Chúa Trời cũng sẽ xét đoán các con thế ấy. Ngài sẽ dùng cho các con chính cái thước mà các con đã dùng cho người khác.

ko.L: 너희가 판단하는 그 판단으로 너희가 판단받을 것이요, 너희가 재는 그 잣대로 너희도 재어질 것이다.
ko.B: 너희가 남을 판단하는 그대로 너희도 판단받을 것이고, 너희가 남에게 대는 잣대가 그대로 너희에게도 쓰일 것이다.
ko.R: 하나님께서는 너희가 남을 판단하는 것과 똑같이 너희를 판단하실 것이다. 너희가 남에게 쓰는 기준을 너희에게도 그대로 쓰실 것이다.

decisions.choice: the measure you measure: the standard you use for others
decisions.reason: The picture is of a merchant measuring grain. Jewish teachers used the saying "measure for measure" of God's justice.

decisions.choice: the main verb first: serán juzgados con el juicio con que juzgan
alternatives: con el juicio con que juzgan serán juzgados
decisions.reason: Spanish can keep the Greek order, but putting the main verb first makes the two halves of the saying easier to follow aloud, and the words are the same.

decisions.choice: "đong bằng đấu" (L, B); "cái thước" (R)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 4:24: "đong" is the everyday verb for measuring out grain and "đấu" the measure. Readable speaks of the standard, as the meaning decision explains the idiom, with "thước" (ruler, standard).

decisions.choice: "잣대" (L, B), "기준" (R) for the measure
decisions.reason: The Greek word is any measure, of grain or of length; the saying is about the standard used on others (meaning decision). "잣대" is the measuring rod that current Korean already uses for a standard of judgment, so the picture and its sense stay together; Readable says "기준".

source.text: τί δὲ βλέπεις τὸ κάρφος τὸ ἐν τῷ ὀφθαλμῷ τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ σου, τὴν δὲ ἐν τῷ σῷ ὀφθαλμῷ δοκὸν οὐ κατανοεῖς;

records.literal_gloss: Why but do you see the speck the in the eye of the brother of you, the but in the your eye beam not you notice?

en.L: And why do you look at the speck in the eye of {{gender:a brother or sister|your brother}}, but do not notice the beam in your own eye?
en.B: Why do you stare at the splinter in the eye of {{gender:a brother or sister|your brother}}, and never notice the beam of wood in your own?
en.R: Why do you notice the tiny bit of dust in the eye of {{gender:a brother or sister|your brother}}, but you do not notice the big piece of wood in your own eye?

es.L: ¿Y por qué ves la brizna que [hay] en el ojo de tu hermano, pero la viga [que hay] en tu propio ojo no la adviertes?
es.B: ¿Por qué te quedas mirando la mota en el ojo de tu hermano y nunca reparas en la viga que hay en el tuyo?
es.R: ¿Por qué ves la pequeña mota de polvo en el ojo de tu hermano, y no te das cuenta del gran pedazo de madera que tienes en tu propio ojo?

fr.L: Et pourquoi regardes-tu la paille qui est dans l’œil {{gender:de ton frère ou de ta sœur|de ton frère}}, mais la poutre qui est dans ton œil, tu ne la remarques pas ?
fr.B: Pourquoi fixes-tu la paille dans l’œil {{gender:de ton frère ou de ta sœur|de ton frère}}, sans jamais remarquer la poutre qui est dans le tien ?
fr.R: Pourquoi remarques-tu un tout petit brin de paille dans l’œil {{gender:de ton frère ou de ta sœur|de ton frère}}, alors que tu ne vois pas le gros morceau de bois dans ton œil à toi ?

sw.L: Na kwa nini unakiona kibanzi kilicho katika jicho la ndugu yako, lakini gogo lililo katika jicho lako mwenyewe hulitambui?
sw.B: Kwa nini unakikodolea macho kibanzi katika jicho la ndugu yako, na hulitambui kamwe gogo lililo katika jicho lako mwenyewe?
sw.R: Kwa nini unaona kipande kidogo cha vumbi katika jicho la ndugu yako, lakini huoni kipande kikubwa cha mti kilicho katika jicho lako mwenyewe?

vi.L: Sao con nhìn thấy cái dằm trong mắt {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} mình, mà không để ý cây đà trong mắt của chính con?
vi.B: Sao con chăm chú nhìn cái dằm trong mắt {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} mình, mà chẳng hề để ý đến cây đà trong mắt chính con?
vi.R: Sao con thấy hạt bụi nhỏ trong mắt {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} mình, mà lại không thấy khúc gỗ lớn trong mắt chính con?

ko.L: 그런데 어찌하여 너는 네 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}의 눈에 있는 티끌은 보면서, 너 자신의 눈에 있는 들보는 살피지 못하느냐?
ko.B: 어찌하여 너는 네 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}의 눈에 든 작은 티끌은 뚫어지게 보면서, 네 눈에 박힌 통나무는 알아채지 못하느냐?
ko.R: 너는 왜 네 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}의 눈에 들어간 작은 먼지는 보면서, 네 눈에 있는 커다란 나무토막은 보지 못하느냐?

decisions.choice: speck and beam: a tiny fault in another and a huge one in oneself
decisions.reason: The speck is a bit of straw or sawdust; the beam is a roof timber. The comic picture shows how blind people are to their own faults while they correct others'.

decisions.choice: {{gender:a brother or sister|your brother}}
decisions.reason: As in 5:22, a brother is a fellow member of God's people, man or woman.

decisions.choice: a tiny bit of dust, a big piece of wood
decisions.reason: Readable describes the two things.

decisions.choice: tu hermano, no gender span
decisions.reason: As in Romans 14:10: Spanish "hermano" in a saying like this covers any fellow member of God's people, man or woman, so there is no gender span here or in verses 4 and 5, where the English has one.

decisions.choice: brizna (L), mota (B); viga
decisions.reason: The Greek word is a tiny chip or speck (meaning decision m1). "Brizna" and "mota" are the smallest things that can get into an eye; "viga", a roof beam, keeps the absurd contrast. The same in verses 4 and 5.

decisions.choice: {{gender:de ton frère ou de ta sœur|de ton frère}}, with the preposition inside the span, as in Luke 6:41; la paille, la poutre (L, B), un tout petit brin de paille, le gros morceau de bois (R)
decisions.reason: French repeats the preposition before each noun ("de ton frère ou de ta sœur"), so the span covers it. The words for speck and beam follow the French already drafted for the parallel in Luke 6:41-42, so the two Gospels read alike. "Son œil" (7:5) refers to either form and needs no span.

decisions.choice: ndugu, no gender span
decisions.reason: "Ndugu" already means a brother or a sister, so Swahili needs no gender span here or in verses 4 and 5, where the English has one.

decisions.choice: kibanzi (splinter); gogo (log)
decisions.reason: The picture is a tiny fault set against a huge one (meaning decision m1). "Gogo", a whole log, makes the absurd size plain to every reader; "boriti" is a building beam. The same in verses 4 and 5.

decisions.choice: "{{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} mình" for "your brother"
decisions.reason: The style guide's gender span for a fellow believer, as the English has "a brother or sister" with "your brother" as the alternative. Used through 7:3-5.

decisions.choice: "cái dằm" and "cây đà" (L, B); "hạt bụi nhỏ" and "khúc gỗ lớn" (R)
decisions.reason: "dằm" is a splinter of wood and "đà" a beam of a house, so Literal and Balanced keep the joke of wood in both eyes; Readable uses the plainer pictures the English Readable uses.

decisions.choice: "네 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}", with the particle "의" outside the span
decisions.reason: As the English, the brother here is any fellow member of God's people, man or woman, so the style guide's span for adelphos applies. The particles after the span ("의", "에게") fit both forms. The same span is used in 7:4-5.

decisions.choice: "티끌" and "들보" (L); "티끌" and "통나무" (B); "먼지" and "나무토막" (R)
decisions.reason: Jesus sets the smallest thing against a roof beam (meaning decision). Literal keeps the beam ("들보"); Balanced uses the plainer "통나무" (log), and Readable everyday words for dust and a piece of wood, as the English Readable does.

source.text: ἢ πῶς ἐρεῖς τῷ ἀδελφῷ σου· Ἄφες ἐκβάλω τὸ κάρφος ἐκ τοῦ ὀφθαλμοῦ σου, καὶ ἰδοὺ ἡ δοκὸς ἐν τῷ ὀφθαλμῷ σοῦ;

records.literal_gloss: Or how will you say to the brother of you, Let me cast out the speck from the eye of you, and behold, the beam in the eye of you?

en.L: Or how will you say to {{gender:a brother or sister|your brother}}, 'Let me take the speck out of your eye,' and look, the beam [is] in your own eye?
en.B: How can you say to {{gender:a brother or sister|your brother}}, 'Let me take that splinter out of your eye,' when all the time there is a beam in your own?
en.R: How can you say to {{gender:a brother or sister|your brother}}, 'Let me get that dust out of your eye,' when you have a big piece of wood in your own eye?

es.L: ¿O cómo dirás a tu hermano: “Deja que saque la brizna de tu ojo”, y mira, la viga [está] en tu ojo?
es.B: ¿Cómo puedes decirle a tu hermano: “Deja que te saque esa mota del ojo”, cuando todo el tiempo hay una viga en el tuyo?
es.R: ¿Cómo puedes decirle a tu hermano: “Déjame quitarte ese polvo del ojo”, si tienes un gran pedazo de madera en tu propio ojo?

fr.L: Ou comment diras-tu à {{gender:ton frère ou à ta sœur|ton frère}} : “Laisse-moi ôter la paille de ton œil”, et voici, la poutre [est] dans ton œil ?
fr.B: Comment peux-tu dire à {{gender:ton frère ou à ta sœur|ton frère}} : “Laisse-moi enlever cette paille de ton œil”, alors que tu as toi-même une poutre dans le tien ?
fr.R: Comment peux-tu dire à {{gender:ton frère ou à ta sœur|ton frère}} : “Laisse-moi enlever ce brin de paille de ton œil”, quand tu as un gros morceau de bois dans ton œil à toi ?

sw.L: Au utamwambiaje ndugu yako, 'Niache nikitoe kibanzi katika jicho lako,' na tazama, gogo [limo] katika jicho lako?
sw.B: Unawezaje kumwambia ndugu yako, 'Acha nikutoe kibanzi hicho jichoni,' wakati wote huo kuna gogo katika jicho lako mwenyewe?
sw.R: Unawezaje kumwambia ndugu yako, 'Acha nikutoe vumbi hilo jichoni,' wakati wewe una kipande kikubwa cha mti katika jicho lako?

vi.L: Hay sao con sẽ nói với {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} mình: 'Để tôi lấy cái dằm ra khỏi mắt anh,' và kìa, cây đà [ở] trong mắt của chính con?
vi.B: Sao con có thể nói với {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} mình: 'Để tôi lấy cái dằm trong mắt anh ra,' trong khi chính trong mắt con có cây đà?
vi.R: Làm sao con có thể nói với {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} mình: 'Để tôi lấy hạt bụi trong mắt anh ra,' trong khi chính trong mắt con có khúc gỗ lớn?

ko.L: 또는 어떻게 네 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}에게 '네 눈에서 티끌을 빼내게 해 다오' 하고 말하겠느냐? 보아라, 네 눈에는 들보가 [있지 않으냐]?
ko.B: 네 눈에는 통나무가 그대로 박혀 있는데, 어떻게 네 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}에게 '네 눈에서 티끌을 빼 주마' 하고 말할 수 있느냐?
ko.R: 네 눈에는 커다란 나무토막이 있는데, 어떻게 네 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}에게 '내가 네 눈에서 먼지를 빼 주마' 하고 말할 수 있느냐?

decisions.choice: speck and beam: a tiny fault in another and a huge one in oneself
decisions.reason: The speck is a bit of straw or sawdust; the beam is a roof timber. The comic picture shows how blind people are to their own faults while they correct others'.

decisions.choice: {{gender:a brother or sister|your brother}}
decisions.reason: As in 5:22, a brother is a fellow member of God's people, man or woman.

decisions.choice: look (L); when all the time (B); when (R)
decisions.reason: The word that points to what follows becomes a contrast in Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: voici (L) (for the whole chapter)
decisions.reason: As in Luke: French "voici" is still current for pointing to what follows, so Literal keeps the word where English Literal says "look"; "regarde" would sound like an order to look. Balanced and Readable carry its force in the sentence, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "tôi" and "anh" in the quoted offer
decisions.reason: Inside the quotation one equal speaks to another; "tôi" and "anh" are the ordinary forms between adults.

source.text: ὑποκριτά, ἔκβαλε πρῶτον ἐκ τοῦ ὀφθαλμοῦ σοῦ τὴν δοκόν, καὶ τότε διαβλέψεις ἐκβαλεῖν τὸ κάρφος ἐκ τοῦ ὀφθαλμοῦ τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ σου.

records.literal_gloss: Hypocrite, cast out first from the eye of you the beam, and then you will see clearly to cast out the speck from the eye of the brother of you.

en.L: Hypocrite! First take the beam out of your own eye, and then you will see clearly to take the speck out of the eye of {{gender:a brother or sister|your brother}}.
en.B: You hypocrite! First take the beam out of your own eye. Then you will see clearly enough to take the splinter out of the eye of {{gender:a brother or sister|your brother}}.
en.R: You are only pretending to be good! First take the piece of wood out of your own eye. Then you will see clearly enough to help {{gender:a brother or sister|your brother}} get the dust out of {{gender:their|his}} eye.

es.L: ¡Hipócrita! Saca primero de tu ojo la viga, y entonces verás con claridad para sacar la brizna del ojo de tu hermano.
es.B: ¡Hipócrita! Primero quita la viga de tu propio ojo. Entonces verás con suficiente claridad para quitar la mota del ojo de tu hermano.
es.R: ¡Solo finges ser bueno! Primero saca el pedazo de madera de tu propio ojo. Entonces verás bien para ayudar a tu hermano a quitarse el polvo del ojo.

fr.L: Hypocrite ! Ôte d’abord la poutre de ton œil, et alors tu verras clair pour ôter la paille de l’œil {{gender:de ton frère ou de ta sœur|de ton frère}}.
fr.B: Hypocrite ! Commence par enlever la poutre de ton propre œil. Ensuite tu verras assez clair pour enlever la paille de l’œil {{gender:de ton frère ou de ta sœur|de ton frère}}.
fr.R: Tu fais semblant d’être bon ! D’abord, enlève le gros morceau de bois de ton œil à toi. Ensuite, tu verras assez clair pour aider {{gender:ton frère ou ta sœur|ton frère}} à enlever le brin de paille de son œil.

sw.L: Mnafiki, toa kwanza gogo katika jicho lako, na ndipo utaona waziwazi kukitoa kibanzi katika jicho la ndugu yako.
sw.B: Wewe mnafiki! Kwanza ondoa gogo katika jicho lako mwenyewe. Ndipo utaona vizuri vya kutosha kukitoa kibanzi katika jicho la ndugu yako.
sw.R: Unajifanya tu kuwa mtu mwema! Kwanza toa kipande cha mti katika jicho lako. Ndipo utaona vizuri, uweze kumsaidia ndugu yako kutoa vumbi katika jicho lake.

vi.L: Hỡi kẻ đạo đức giả! Trước hết hãy lấy cây đà ra khỏi mắt con, rồi con sẽ thấy rõ để lấy cái dằm ra khỏi mắt {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} mình.
vi.B: Hỡi kẻ đạo đức giả! Trước hết hãy lấy cây đà ra khỏi mắt mình. Rồi con mới thấy rõ để lấy cái dằm ra khỏi mắt {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} mình.
vi.R: Con chỉ giả vờ làm người tốt! Trước hết hãy lấy khúc gỗ ra khỏi mắt mình. Rồi con mới thấy rõ để giúp {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} mình lấy hạt bụi ra khỏi mắt.

ko.L: 위선자야, 먼저 네 눈에서 들보를 빼내어라. 그런 다음에야 네가 똑똑히 보고 네 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}의 눈에서 티끌을 빼낼 수 있을 것이다.
ko.B: 이 위선자야! 먼저 네 눈에서 통나무를 빼내어라. 그래야 네가 똑똑히 보고 네 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}의 눈에서 티끌을 빼 줄 수 있다.
ko.R: 위선자야! 너는 착한 척만 하는구나. 먼저 네 눈에서 나무토막을 빼내어라. 그러면 똑똑히 보고 네 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}의 눈에 있는 먼지를 빼 줄 수 있을 것이다.

decisions.choice: hypocrite: one who plays a part, here by correcting others while ignoring one's own sin
decisions.reason: As in 6:2, the word first meant an actor.

decisions.choice: then you will see clearly: help is still to be given, after self-examination
decisions.reason: Jesus does not forbid helping another with a fault; he tells the helper to deal with his own first (compare 18:15).

decisions.choice: {{gender:a brother or sister|your brother}}
decisions.reason: As in 5:22, a brother is a fellow member of God's people, man or woman.

decisions.choice: You are only pretending to be good!
decisions.reason: Readable says what a hypocrite is.

decisions.choice: "위선자야! 너는 착한 척만 하는구나" (R)
decisions.reason: Readable keeps "위선자", as in 6:2 and Mark 7:6, and adds what it means, as the English Readable does ("you are only pretending to be good").

source.text: Μὴ δῶτε τὸ ἅγιον τοῖς κυσίν, μηδὲ βάλητε τοὺς μαργαρίτας ὑμῶν ἔμπροσθεν τῶν χοίρων, μήποτε καταπατήσουσιν αὐτοὺς ἐν τοῖς ποσὶν αὐτῶν καὶ στραφέντες ῥήξωσιν ὑμᾶς.

records.literal_gloss: Not give the holy to the dogs, nor throw the pearls of you before the pigs, lest they trample them with the feet of them and having turned they tear you.

en.L: Do not give what is holy to the dogs, nor throw your pearls before the pigs, lest they trample them under their feet and turn and tear you to pieces.
en.B: Do not give holy things to dogs, and do not throw your pearls to pigs. They may trample them underfoot and then turn on you and tear you apart.
en.R: Do not give holy things to dogs. Do not throw your pearls in front of pigs. They will only walk on them, and then they will turn and attack you.

es.L: No {{plural_you:entreguen|entreguéis}} lo sagrado a los perros, ni {{plural_you:arrojen|arrojéis}} {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} perlas ante los cerdos, no vaya a ser que las pisoteen con sus patas y, dándose vuelta, {{plural_you:los|os}} hagan pedazos.
es.B: No {{plural_you:den|deis}} las cosas santas a los perros, ni {{plural_you:tiren|tiréis}} {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} perlas a los cerdos. Podrían pisotearlas y luego revolverse contra {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} y {{plural_you:despedazarlos|despedazaros}}.
es.R: No {{plural_you:den|deis}} cosas santas a los perros. No {{plural_you:tiren|tiréis}} {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} perlas delante de los cerdos. Solo las pisotearán, y después se volverán y {{plural_you:los|os}} atacarán.

fr.L: Ne donnez pas ce qui est saint aux chiens, et ne jetez pas vos perles devant les porcs, de peur qu’ils ne les piétinent de leurs pieds et que, se retournant, ils ne vous déchirent.
fr.B: Ne donnez pas les choses saintes aux chiens, et ne jetez pas vos perles aux porcs. Ils risqueraient de les piétiner, puis de se retourner contre vous et de vous mettre en pièces.
fr.R: Ne donnez pas les choses saintes aux chiens. Ne jetez pas vos perles devant les cochons. Ils vont seulement marcher dessus, et ensuite ils vont se retourner et vous attaquer.

sw.L: Msiwape mbwa kitu kitakatifu, wala msitupe lulu zenu mbele ya nguruwe, isije ikawa wanazikanyaga kwa miguu yao, na kugeuka wakawararua.
sw.B: Msiwape mbwa vitu vitakatifu, wala msiwarushie nguruwe lulu zenu. Huenda wakazikanyaga, kisha wakawageukia na kuwararua.
sw.R: Msiwape mbwa vitu vitakatifu. Msitupe lulu zenu mbele ya nguruwe. Watazikanyaga tu, kisha watawageukia na kuwashambulia.

vi.L: Đừng cho chó vật thánh, cũng đừng ném ngọc trai của các con trước mặt heo, kẻo chúng giẫm đạp dưới chân rồi quay lại cắn xé các con.
vi.B: Đừng cho chó những vật thánh, cũng đừng ném ngọc trai của các con cho heo. Chúng sẽ giẫm nát dưới chân rồi quay lại cắn xé các con.
vi.R: Đừng cho chó những vật thánh. Đừng ném ngọc trai của các con trước mặt heo. Chúng chỉ giẫm lên ngọc trai, rồi quay lại tấn công các con.

ko.L: 거룩한 것을 개들에게 주지 말고, 너희 진주들을 돼지들 앞에 내던지지도 마라. 그것들이 진주들을 발로 짓밟고, 돌아서서 너희를 물어뜯을지도 모른다.
ko.B: 거룩한 것을 개에게 주지 말고, 너희 진주를 돼지에게 던져 주지 마라. 돼지들은 진주를 발로 짓밟고, 돌아서서 너희에게 달려들어 물어뜯을 것이다.
ko.R: 거룩한 것을 개에게 주지 마라. 너희 진주를 돼지 앞에 던지지 마라. 돼지들은 진주를 발로 밟아 버리고, 돌아서서 너희를 공격할 것이다.

decisions.choice: dogs and pigs: people who scorn and attack what is holy
alternatives: all who do not yet believe
decisions.reason: Dogs and pigs were unclean animals. The holy thing may be meat offered in sacrifice. The saying balances 7:1-5: do not condemn, but do not keep pressing God's good things on those who treat them with contempt. Who is meant is not said.

decisions.choice: what is holy: food set apart for God, such as sacrificial meat
decisions.reason: Meat from the sacrifices was holy and could be eaten only by priests or worshipers (Exodus 29:33; Leviticus 22:10). Throwing it to dogs would be unthinkable.

decisions.choice: les porcs (L, B); les cochons (R)
decisions.reason: "Pourceaux" is old Bible French. "Porcs" is the standard word, "cochons" the everyday one, as in the French of Mark 5.

decisions.choice: "ngọc trai" for pearls; "heo" for pigs
decisions.reason: "ngọc trai" is the everyday word. "heo" as in Mark 5:11, where a reviewer may choose "lợn" for the whole Bible.

source.text: Αἰτεῖτε, καὶ δοθήσεται ὑμῖν· ζητεῖτε, καὶ εὑρήσετε· κρούετε, καὶ ἀνοιγήσεται ὑμῖν.

records.literal_gloss: Ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and it will be opened to you.

en.L: Ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and it will be opened to you.
en.B: Keep asking, and you will receive. Keep seeking, and you will find. Keep knocking, and the door will be opened for you.
en.R: Keep on asking God, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will give to you. Keep on looking, and you will find. Keep on knocking, and the door will open for you.

es.L: {{plural_you:Pidan|Pedid}}, y se {{plural_you:les|os}} dará; {{plural_you:busquen|buscad}}, y {{plural_you:encontrarán|encontraréis}}; {{plural_you:toquen|tocad}}, y se {{plural_you:les|os}} abrirá.
es.B: {{plural_you:Sigan|Seguid}} pidiendo, y {{plural_you:recibirán|recibiréis}}. {{plural_you:Sigan|Seguid}} buscando, y {{plural_you:encontrarán|encontraréis}}. {{plural_you:Sigan|Seguid}} tocando a la puerta, y se {{plural_you:les|os}} abrirá.
es.R: {{plural_you:Sigan|Seguid}} pidiéndole a Dios, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} {{plural_you:les|os}} dará. {{plural_you:Sigan|Seguid}} buscando, y {{plural_you:encontrarán|encontraréis}}. {{plural_you:Sigan|Seguid}} tocando a la puerta, y se {{plural_you:les|os}} abrirá.

fr.L: Demandez, et il vous sera donné ; cherchez, et vous trouverez ; frappez, et il vous sera ouvert.
fr.B: Continuez à demander, et vous recevrez. Continuez à chercher, et vous trouverez. Continuez à frapper, et la porte vous sera ouverte.
fr.R: Continuez à demander à Dieu, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vous donnera. Continuez à chercher, et vous trouverez. Continuez à frapper, et la porte s’ouvrira pour vous.

sw.L: Ombeni, na mtapewa; tafuteni, na mtapata; bisheni hodi, na mtafunguliwa.
sw.B: Endeleeni kuomba, nanyi mtapokea. Endeleeni kutafuta, nanyi mtapata. Endeleeni kubisha hodi, nanyi mtafunguliwa mlango.
sw.R: Endeleeni kumwomba Mungu, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} atawapa. Endeleeni kutafuta, nanyi mtapata. Endeleeni kubisha hodi, na mlango utafunguliwa kwa ajili yenu.

vi.L: Hãy xin, thì sẽ được cho các con; hãy tìm, thì các con sẽ gặp; hãy gõ cửa, thì sẽ được mở cho các con.
vi.B: Hãy cứ xin, các con sẽ nhận được. Hãy cứ tìm, các con sẽ gặp. Hãy cứ gõ cửa, cửa sẽ mở cho các con.
vi.R: Hãy cứ cầu xin Đức Chúa Trời, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ ban cho các con. Hãy cứ tìm, các con sẽ tìm thấy. Hãy cứ gõ cửa, cửa sẽ mở ra cho các con.

ko.L: 구하여라, 그러면 너희에게 주어질 것이다. 찾아라, 그러면 너희가 찾아낼 것이다. 두드려라, 그러면 너희에게 열릴 것이다.
ko.B: 계속 구하여라. 그러면 받을 것이다. 계속 찾아라. 그러면 찾아낼 것이다. 계속 문을 두드려라. 그러면 문이 열릴 것이다.
ko.R: 하나님께 계속 구하여라. 그러면 하나님께서 주실 것이다. 계속 찾아라. 그러면 찾게 될 것이다. 계속 문을 두드려라. 그러면 문이 열릴 것이다.

decisions.choice: ask, seek, knock: keep on doing so
decisions.reason: The commands are in the present tense, which can mean to go on asking. The three verbs say the same thing three ways: pray to God with confidence.

decisions.choice: it will be given, it will be opened: God will give and open
decisions.reason: The passives point to God, as 7:11 shows.

decisions.choice: keep asking, keep seeking, keep knocking
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable bring out the present tense.

decisions.choice: asking God, he will give
decisions.reason: Readable names God.

decisions.choice: tocar (a la puerta)
decisions.reason: Both are used for knocking at a door. "Tocar a la puerta" is the plainer everyday phrase across the Spanish-speaking world, and "llamar" is also "call". The same in verse 8.

decisions.choice: kubisha hodi
decisions.reason: "Kubisha hodi" is the ordinary Swahili for knocking or calling at someone's door to be let in; "kugonga" is striking anything. The same in verse 8.

decisions.choice: "hãy cứ xin", "hãy cứ tìm", "hãy cứ gõ cửa" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the commands as "keep on doing so"; "cứ" says that in Vietnamese without heaviness.

source.text: πᾶς γὰρ ὁ αἰτῶν λαμβάνει καὶ ὁ ζητῶν εὑρίσκει καὶ τῷ κρούοντι ἀνοιγήσεται.

records.literal_gloss: Everyone for the asking receives and the seeking finds and to the knocking it will be opened.

en.L: For everyone who asks receives, and the one who seeks finds, and to the one who knocks it will be opened.
en.B: For everyone who asks receives, whoever seeks finds, and the door is opened to whoever knocks.
en.R: Everyone who keeps asking will receive. Everyone who keeps looking will find. And the door will be opened to everyone who keeps knocking.

es.L: Porque todo el que pide recibe, y el que busca encuentra, y al que toca se le abrirá.
es.B: Porque todo el que pide recibe, quien busca encuentra, y a quien toca a la puerta se le abre.
es.R: Todo el que sigue pidiendo recibirá. Todo el que sigue buscando encontrará. Y a todo el que sigue tocando a la puerta se le abrirá.

fr.L: Car quiconque demande reçoit, et celui qui cherche trouve, et à celui qui frappe il sera ouvert.
fr.B: Car celui qui demande reçoit, celui qui cherche trouve, et l’on ouvre à celui qui frappe.
fr.R: Tous ceux qui continuent à demander recevront. Tous ceux qui continuent à chercher trouveront. Et la porte s’ouvrira pour tous ceux qui continuent à frapper.

sw.L: Kwa maana kila mtu anayeomba hupokea, na anayetafuta hupata, na anayebisha hodi atafunguliwa.
sw.B: Kwa maana kila anayeomba hupokea, yeyote anayetafuta hupata, na anayebisha hodi hufunguliwa mlango.
sw.R: Kila mtu anayeendelea kuomba atapokea. Kila anayeendelea kutafuta atapata. Na kila anayeendelea kubisha hodi atafunguliwa mlango.

vi.L: Vì hễ ai xin thì nhận được, ai tìm thì gặp, và ai gõ cửa thì sẽ được mở cho.
vi.B: Vì ai xin thì nhận được, ai tìm thì gặp, và ai gõ cửa thì cửa sẽ mở ra.
vi.R: Ai cứ xin thì sẽ nhận được. Ai cứ tìm thì sẽ tìm thấy. Ai cứ gõ cửa thì cửa sẽ mở ra cho người ấy.

ko.L: 구하는 사람은 누구나 받고, 찾는 사람은 찾아내고, 두드리는 사람에게는 열릴 것이다.
ko.B: 누구든지 구하는 사람은 받고, 찾는 사람은 찾아내고, 두드리는 사람에게는 문이 열린다.
ko.R: 계속 구하는 사람은 누구나 받는다. 계속 찾는 사람은 찾아낸다. 계속 문을 두드리는 사람에게는 문이 열린다.

decisions.choice: everyone who asks receives: God answers his children
alternatives: a promise to grant anything requested
decisions.reason: The promise rests on God's goodness as Father (7:11). It is given to disciples who seek his kingdom (6:33), not as a guarantee of whatever they want.

source.text: ἢ τίς ἐστιν ἐξ ὑμῶν ἄνθρωπος, ὃν αἰτήσει ὁ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ ἄρτον μὴ λίθον ἐπιδώσει αὐτῷ;

records.literal_gloss: Or who is from you a man, whom will ask the son of him bread, not a stone will he give him?

en.L: Or what person is there among you who, if {{gender:your child|your son}} asks for bread, will give {{gender:them|him}} a stone?
en.B: Would any of you give {{gender:your child|your son}} a stone when {{gender:they|he}} asked for bread?
en.R: Suppose {{gender:your child|your son}} asks you for bread. You would not give {{gender:them|him}} a stone, would you?

es.L: ¿O qué persona hay entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} que, si su hijo le pide pan, le dará una piedra?
es.B: ¿Quién de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} le daría una piedra a su hijo si le pidiera pan?
es.R: {{plural_you:Supongan|Suponed}} que {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} hijo {{plural_you:les|os}} pide pan. No le {{plural_you:darían|daríais}} una piedra, ¿verdad?

fr.L: Ou quelle personne y a-t-il parmi vous qui, si son {{gender:enfant|fils}} lui demande du pain, lui donnera une pierre ?
fr.B: Qui d’entre vous donnerait une pierre à son {{gender:enfant|fils}} quand il lui demande du pain ?
fr.R: Imaginez que votre {{gender:enfant|fils}} vous demande du pain. Vous ne lui donneriez pas une pierre, n’est-ce pas ?

sw.L: Au ni nani kati yenu, mtu ambaye mtoto wake atamwomba mkate, naye atampa jiwe?
sw.B: Je, yupo mmoja wenu ambaye angempa mtoto wake jiwe alipomwomba mkate?
sw.R: Tuseme mtoto wa mmoja wenu anamwomba mkate. Hangempa jiwe, sivyo?

vi.L: Hay có người nào trong các con, nếu con mình xin bánh, mà lại cho nó hòn đá?
vi.B: Có ai trong các con khi con mình xin bánh lại cho nó hòn đá không?
vi.R: Giả sử con của các con xin bánh. Các con đâu có cho nó hòn đá, phải không?

ko.L: 또는 너희 가운데 어떤 사람이, 빵을 달라고 하는 {{gender:자녀|아들}}에게 돌을 주겠느냐?
ko.B: 너희 가운데 누가 빵을 달라는 {{gender:자녀|아들}}에게 돌을 주겠느냐?
ko.R: 너희 가운데 빵을 달라는 {{gender:자녀|아들}}에게 돌을 줄 사람은 없을 것이다.

decisions.choice: a question that expects the answer "no one"
decisions.reason: The Greek form shows the answer expected: no parent would do it.

decisions.choice: bread and a stone: a round loaf and a stone of the same shape
decisions.reason: A small round loaf looked like a stone (4:3). The cruel trick would be to give something like what was asked for, but useless.

decisions.choice: {{gender:your child|your son}}
decisions.reason: The point is a parent's care for any child, so the inclusive form is the default.

decisions.choice: hijo, no gender span
decisions.reason: The English has a gender span ("your child|your son"). In a general case like this the Spanish "hijo" is heard as any child, so there is no span here or in verse 10, where "le" serves for a son or a daughter.

decisions.choice: son {{gender:enfant|fils}}, with no span on the pronouns that follow ("il", "lui") here and in 7:10
decisions.reason: French "enfant" and "fils" are both masculine, so the pronouns that refer back to them read the same with either option and need no span where the English has "they|he" and "them|him". Literal says "quelle personne" for the Greek "what man", a generic phrase that needs no setting.

decisions.choice: mtoto, no gender span
decisions.reason: The Greek says "son"; the English gives "your child|your son" as a setting. "Mtoto" is a son or a daughter, and the picture is any parent with a child, so Swahili needs no span here or in verse 10.

decisions.choice: "con mình" and "nó" with no gender span
decisions.reason: "con" (child) is already inclusive in Vietnamese, and "nó" is the ordinary pronoun for one's own child, so the English gender spans have no counterpart (the style guide uses a span only where Vietnamese has two ways of saying the same thing).

decisions.choice: "{{gender:자녀|아들}}" with "에게" after the span; no span for the pronouns of 7:10
decisions.reason: As in the English, the saying is about any child, so the son is put under the gender setting; Korean has both words. The sentence is built so that the particle after the span ("에게") fits both forms. Korean needs no pronoun for the child in 7:10, so that verse has no span.

source.text: ἢ καὶ ἰχθὺν αἰτήσει μὴ ὄφιν ἐπιδώσει αὐτῷ;

records.literal_gloss: Or also a fish he will ask, not a snake will he give him?

en.L: Or if {{gender:they|he}} asks for a fish, will [you] give {{gender:them|him}} a snake?
en.B: Or give {{gender:them|him}} a snake when {{gender:they|he}} asked for a fish?
en.R: If {{gender:they|he}} asks for a fish, you would not give {{gender:them|him}} a snake!

es.L: ¿O si también pide un pez, le dará una serpiente?
es.B: ¿O le daría una serpiente si le pidiera un pescado?
es.R: Si {{plural_you:les|os}} pide un pescado, no le {{plural_you:darían|daríais}} una serpiente.

fr.L: Ou encore, s’il demande un poisson, lui donnera-t-il un serpent ?
fr.B: Ou qui lui donnerait un serpent quand il demande un poisson ?
fr.R: Et s’il vous demande un poisson, vous ne lui donneriez pas un serpent !

sw.L: Au pia ataomba samaki, je, atampa nyoka?
sw.B: Au angempa nyoka alipomwomba samaki?
sw.R: Akimwomba samaki, hangempa nyoka!

vi.L: Hay nếu nó xin cá, lại cho nó con rắn?
vi.B: Hoặc khi nó xin cá, lại cho nó con rắn sao?
vi.R: Nếu nó xin cá, các con đâu có cho nó con rắn!

ko.L: 또 생선을 달라고 하는데 뱀을 주겠느냐?
ko.B: 생선을 달라는데 뱀을 주겠느냐?
ko.R: 생선을 달라는데 뱀을 줄 사람도 없을 것이다!

decisions.choice: a fish and a snake: something like a fish that could harm
decisions.reason: Some fish of the Sea of Galilee look like snakes, and a snake was unclean food. The second picture repeats the first.

source.text: εἰ οὖν ὑμεῖς πονηροὶ ὄντες οἴδατε δόματα ἀγαθὰ διδόναι τοῖς τέκνοις ὑμῶν, πόσῳ μᾶλλον ὁ πατὴρ ὑμῶν ὁ ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς δώσει ἀγαθὰ τοῖς αἰτοῦσιν αὐτόν.

records.literal_gloss: If therefore you evil being know gifts good to give to the children of you, how much more the Father of you the in the heavens will give good things to the asking him.

en.L: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father who [is] in the heavens give good things to those who ask {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}!
en.B: So if you, sinful as you are, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven give good things to those who ask {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}!
en.R: You are sinful, but you still know how to give good things to your children. So you can be sure that your Father in heaven will give good things to those who ask {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: Si, pues, {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, siendo malos, {{plural_you:saben|sabéis}} dar buenos regalos a {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} hijos, ¡cuánto más {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Padre que [está] en los cielos dará cosas buenas a los que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} piden!
es.B: Así que si {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, aun siendo pecadores, {{plural_you:saben|sabéis}} dar buenos regalos a {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} hijos, ¡cuánto más {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Padre que está en el cielo dará cosas buenas a quienes {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} piden!
es.R: {{plural_you:Ustedes son|Vosotros sois}} pecadores, pero aun así {{plural_you:saben|sabéis}} dar cosas buenas a {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} hijos. Así que {{plural_you:pueden|podéis}} estar seguros de que {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Padre que está en el cielo dará cosas buenas a quienes {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} piden.

fr.L: Si donc vous, qui êtes mauvais, savez donner de bons dons à vos enfants, combien plus votre Père qui [est] dans les cieux donnera-t-il de bonnes choses à ceux qui les {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} demandent !
fr.B: Si donc vous, pécheurs comme vous l’êtes, vous savez donner de bonnes choses à vos enfants, à combien plus forte raison votre Père qui est au ciel donnera-t-il de bonnes choses à ceux qui les {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} demandent !
fr.R: Vous êtes pécheurs, et pourtant vous savez donner de bonnes choses à vos enfants. Alors vous pouvez être sûrs que votre Père qui est au ciel donnera de bonnes choses à ceux qui les {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} demandent.

sw.L: Basi ikiwa ninyi, ingawa ni waovu, mnajua kuwapa watoto wenu zawadi nzuri, ni zaidi sana jinsi gani Baba yenu aliye mbinguni atawapa mambo mema wale wanaomwomba!
sw.B: Basi ikiwa ninyi, pamoja na kuwa wenye dhambi, mnajua kuwapa watoto wenu zawadi nzuri, Baba yenu aliye mbinguni atawapa mambo mema zaidi sana wale wanaomwomba!
sw.R: Ninyi ni wenye dhambi, lakini bado mnajua kuwapa watoto wenu vitu vizuri. Basi mnaweza kuwa na hakika kwamba Baba yenu aliye mbinguni atawapa mambo mema wale wanaomwomba.

vi.L: Vậy nếu các con, vốn là xấu xa, còn biết cho con cái mình những món quà tốt, thì Cha các con, Đấng ở trên các tầng trời, càng ban những điều tốt cho những người xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} biết bao!
vi.B: Vậy nếu các con, dù tội lỗi, còn biết cho con cái mình những món quà tốt, thì Cha các con ở trên trời lại càng ban những điều tốt lành cho những người cầu xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} biết bao!
vi.R: Các con là người tội lỗi, vậy mà còn biết cho con cái mình những điều tốt. Vậy các con có thể chắc chắn rằng Cha các con ở trên trời sẽ ban những điều tốt lành cho những người cầu xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그러므로 너희가 악한 자들이면서도 너희 자녀들에게 좋은 선물들을 줄 줄 안다면, 하늘에 계신 너희 아버지께서는 그분께 구하는 사람들에게 얼마나 더 좋은 것들을 주시겠느냐!
ko.B: 너희가 악한 사람들이면서도 자녀에게 좋은 것을 줄 줄 안다면, 하늘에 계신 너희 아버지께서는 그분께 구하는 사람들에게 얼마나 더 좋은 것을 주시겠느냐!
ko.R: 너희는 악하지만, 그래도 자녀에게 좋은 것을 줄 줄 안다. 그러니 하늘에 계신 너희 아버지께서는 그분께 구하는 사람들에게 틀림없이 좋은 것을 주실 것이다.

decisions.choice: being evil: sinful, even at your best
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks of human beings as sinful by nature, set against the goodness of the Father. Even so, they care for their children.

decisions.choice: how much more: from the lesser to the greater
alternatives: God is like a human father in every way
decisions.reason: As in 6:26 and 6:30, the argument runs from human care to God's far greater care.

decisions.choice: sinful
decisions.reason: "Evil" in English suggests special wickedness; Balanced and Readable say "sinful", as the meaning note explains.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun span on wanaomwomba (who ask him)
decisions.reason: The English "him" takes the setting. Swahili carries it in the object prefix -m- of the verb, which cannot take a capital, so the setting applies only to free pronouns and possessives, as in John. Swahili therefore has fewer spans than English throughout the chapter.

decisions.choice: "xấu xa" (L); "tội lỗi" (B, R) for "being evil"
decisions.reason: The meaning decision says the word means sinful, even at one's best; "gian ác" would make the parents wicked, which is not the point.

source.text: Πάντα οὖν ὅσα ἐὰν θέλητε ἵνα ποιῶσιν ὑμῖν οἱ ἄνθρωποι, οὕτως καὶ ὑμεῖς ποιεῖτε αὐτοῖς· οὗτος γάρ ἐστιν ὁ νόμος καὶ οἱ προφῆται.

records.literal_gloss: All things therefore as many as you want that should do to you the men, so also you do to them; this for is the law and the prophets.

en.L: So everything that you want {{gender:people|men}} to do to you, so also do to them; for this is the law and the prophets.
en.B: So in everything, treat others the way you would want them to treat you, for this is what the law and the prophets are about.
en.R: Do for other people everything you want them to do for you. That is what the law of Moses and the teachings of the prophets are all about.

es.L: Por tanto, todo lo que {{plural_you:deseen|deseéis}} que {{gender:los seres humanos|los hombres}} {{plural_you:les|os}} hagan, así también {{plural_you:hagan|haced}} {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} por ellos; pues esto es la ley y los profetas.
es.B: Por eso, en todo, {{plural_you:hagan|haced}} por los demás lo que {{plural_you:querrían|querríais}} que ellos hicieran por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. De eso tratan la ley y los profetas.
es.R: {{plural_you:Hagan|Haced}} por los demás todo lo que {{plural_you:quieren|queréis}} que ellos hagan por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. De eso tratan la ley de Moisés y las enseñanzas de los profetas.

fr.L: Ainsi, tout ce que vous voulez que les {{gender:gens|hommes}} fassent pour vous, faites-le, vous aussi, pour eux ; car c’est la Loi et les prophètes.
fr.B: Ainsi, en toutes choses, traitez les autres comme vous voudriez qu’ils vous traitent : c’est là tout le sens de la Loi et des prophètes.
fr.R: Faites pour les autres tout ce que vous voulez qu’ils fassent pour vous. C’est cela que veulent dire la Loi de Moïse et l’enseignement des prophètes.

sw.L: Basi kila kitu mnachotaka watu wawafanyie, hivyo hivyo ninyi pia wafanyieni wao; kwa maana hii ndiyo sheria na manabii.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo, katika kila jambo, wafanyieni wengine kama mnavyotaka wao wawafanyie ninyi, kwa maana hilo ndilo kiini cha sheria na manabii.
sw.R: Wafanyieni watu wengine kila kitu mnachotaka wao wawafanyie ninyi. Hilo ndilo jambo kuu la sheria ya Musa na mafundisho ya manabii.

vi.L: Vậy tất cả những gì các con muốn người ta làm cho mình, thì các con cũng hãy làm như vậy cho họ; vì đây là luật pháp và các tiên tri.
vi.B: Vậy trong mọi việc, hãy đối xử với người khác như các con muốn họ đối xử với mình, vì đó là cốt lõi của luật pháp và các sách tiên tri.
vi.R: Hãy làm cho người khác mọi điều các con muốn họ làm cho mình. Đó là tóm tắt tất cả những gì luật pháp Môi-se và lời các nhà tiên tri dạy.

ko.L: 그러므로 무엇이든지 사람들이 너희에게 해 주기를 너희가 원하는 대로, 너희도 그들에게 그렇게 해 주어라. 이것이 율법과 예언자들이기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그러므로 모든 일에서, 사람들이 너희에게 해 주기를 바라는 그대로 너희도 그들에게 해 주어라. 율법과 예언자들이 말하는 것이 바로 이것이다.
ko.R: 다른 사람들이 너희에게 해 주기를 바라는 것을 너희도 다른 사람들에게 다 해 주어라. 모세의 율법과 예언자들의 가르침이 말하는 것이 바로 이것이다.

decisions.choice: do to others what you want them to do to you: a positive rule of love
alternatives: do not do to others what you would not want
decisions.reason: Others, including the teacher Hillel, had taught the negative form: do not do to others what you hate. Jesus states it positively, as a call to act.

decisions.choice: this is the law and the prophets: this sums up the Scriptures
alternatives: this replaces the law and the prophets
decisions.reason: The phrase ties back to 5:17. Jesus says the same of the two great commands in 22:40.

decisions.choice: the law of Moses and the teachings of the prophets
decisions.reason: As in 5:17.

decisions.choice: la Loi, capitalised (for the whole chapter); les {{gender:gens|hommes}} (L)
decisions.reason: The Law of Moses takes the capital set in the style guide. At Literal "les gens" is the plain inclusive word for "people" in a saying about daily conduct; "les humains" would sound abstract here.

decisions.choice: "luật pháp và các sách tiên tri" (B); "luật pháp Môi-se và lời các nhà tiên tri" (R)
alternatives: luật pháp và các tiên tri (B)
decisions.reason: The phrase names the Scriptures (meaning decision). Balanced says "các sách tiên tri" so that a reader does not take the prophets as people; Readable names Moses as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "율법과 예언자들"
decisions.reason: "예언자" is the current word the style guide prefers to the older "선지자". The phrase names the Scriptures by their parts (meaning decision); Korean keeps the people, as the Greek does, and Readable says that their teaching is meant.

source.text: Εἰσέλθατε διὰ τῆς στενῆς πύλης· ὅτι πλατεῖα ἡ πύλη καὶ εὐρύχωρος ἡ ὁδὸς ἡ ἀπάγουσα εἰς τὴν ἀπώλειαν, καὶ πολλοί εἰσιν οἱ εἰσερχόμενοι δι’ αὐτῆς·

records.literal_gloss: Enter through the narrow gate; for wide the gate and broad the road the leading to the destruction, and many are the entering through it;

en.L: Enter through the narrow gate; for wide [is] the gate and broad the road that leads to destruction, and many are those who enter through it,
en.B: Go in through the narrow gate. The gate that leads to destruction is wide and the road to it is easy, and many go in that way.
en.R: Enter through the narrow gate. The gate and road that lead to ruin are wide and easy, and many people go that way.

es.L: {{plural_you:Entren|Entrad}} por la puerta angosta; pues amplia [es] la puerta y ancho el camino que conduce a la destrucción, y muchos son los que entran por ella,
es.B: {{plural_you:Entren|Entrad}} por la puerta estrecha. La puerta que lleva a la destrucción es ancha, y el camino hacia ella es fácil, y muchos entran por allí.
es.R: {{plural_you:Entren|Entrad}} por la puerta estrecha. La puerta y el camino que llevan a la ruina son anchos y fáciles, y mucha gente va por ahí.

fr.L: Entrez par la porte étroite ; car large [est] la porte et spacieux le chemin qui mène à la perdition, et nombreux sont ceux qui entrent par elle ;
fr.B: Entrez par la porte étroite. La porte qui mène à la perdition est large, et le chemin qui y conduit est facile ; et beaucoup passent par là.
fr.R: Entrez par la porte étroite. La porte et le chemin qui mènent à la ruine sont larges et faciles, et beaucoup de gens passent par là.

sw.L: Ingieni kupitia lango jembamba; kwa maana pana ni lango na yenye nafasi ni njia iendayo kwenye maangamizi, na wengi ni wale wanaoingia kupitia [lango] hilo,
sw.B: Ingieni kupitia lango jembamba. Lango linaloelekea kwenye maangamizi ni pana, na njia yake ni rahisi, na wengi hupita hapo.
sw.R: Ingieni kupitia lango jembamba. Lango na njia vinavyoelekea kwenye uharibifu ni pana na rahisi, na watu wengi hupita njia hiyo.

vi.L: Hãy vào qua cửa hẹp; vì cửa rộng và đường thênh thang dẫn đến sự hủy diệt, và có nhiều người đi vào qua đó;
vi.B: Hãy vào qua cửa hẹp. Cửa dẫn đến sự hủy diệt thì rộng, đường đến đó thì dễ đi, và nhiều người vào qua đó.
vi.R: Hãy đi vào qua cửa hẹp. Cửa và con đường dẫn đến chỗ hư mất thì rộng và dễ đi, và có nhiều người đi lối đó.

ko.L: 좁은 문으로 들어가라. 멸망으로 데려가는 문은 넓고 그 길은 널찍하여, 그 문으로 들어가는 사람들이 많기 때문이다.
ko.B: 좁은 문으로 들어가거라. 멸망으로 가는 문은 넓고 그 길은 걷기 쉬워서, 많은 사람이 그리로 들어간다.
ko.R: 좁은 문으로 들어가라. 망하는 곳으로 가는 문과 길은 넓고 편하다. 그래서 많은 사람이 그 길로 간다.

decisions.choice: two ways: the choice between life and death
decisions.reason: Moses set before Israel the way of life and the way of death (Deuteronomy 30:15-19; Jeremiah 21:8). The gate may be the entrance to the kingdom, at the start or the end of the road.

decisions.choice: destruction: final ruin at God's judgment
decisions.reason: The word is the opposite of life in 7:14, the life of the kingdom.

decisions.choice: easy
decisions.reason: The broad road is the easy one; Balanced says so.

decisions.choice: la destrucción
decisions.reason: The word means final ruin at God's judgment (meaning decision m2). "Destrucción" says that in today's Spanish; "perdición" is now heard mostly as moral ruin.

decisions.choice: lango
decisions.reason: The Greek word is a large gate, such as a city gate, set beside a road. "Lango" is that gate; "mlango" is the door of a house. The same in verse 14.

decisions.choice: "sự hủy diệt" (L, B); "chỗ hư mất" (R) for destruction
decisions.reason: The meaning decision says final ruin at God's judgment is meant. "hủy diệt" is the plain word for destruction; Readable says "hư mất" (be lost, ruined), the word the Vietnamese John uses for those who perish.

source.text: ὅτι στενὴ ἡ πύλη καὶ τεθλιμμένη ἡ ὁδὸς ἡ ἀπάγουσα εἰς τὴν ζωήν, καὶ ὀλίγοι εἰσὶν οἱ εὑρίσκοντες αὐτήν.

records.literal_gloss: for narrow the gate and pressed the road the leading to the life, and few are the finding it.

en.L: for narrow [is] the gate and hard the road that leads to life, and few are those who find it.
en.B: But the gate that leads to life is narrow and the road is hard, and only a few find it.
en.R: But the gate and road that lead to life are narrow and hard. Only a few people find them.

es.L: porque angosta [es] la puerta y apretado el camino que conduce a la vida, y pocos son los que lo encuentran.
es.B: Pero la puerta que lleva a la vida es estrecha y el camino es difícil, y solo unos pocos lo encuentran.
es.R: Pero la puerta y el camino que llevan a la vida son estrechos y difíciles. Solo unas pocas personas los encuentran.

fr.L: car étroite [est] la porte et resserré le chemin qui mène à la vie, et peu nombreux sont ceux qui le trouvent.
fr.B: Mais la porte qui mène à la vie est étroite, et le chemin est difficile, et seuls quelques-uns le trouvent.
fr.R: Mais la porte et le chemin qui mènent à la vie sont étroits et difficiles. Seulement quelques personnes les trouvent.

sw.L: kwa maana jembamba ni lango na yenye dhiki ni njia iendayo kwenye uzima, na wachache ni wale wanaoipata.
sw.B: Lakini lango linaloelekea kwenye uzima ni jembamba, na njia yake ni ngumu, na ni wachache tu wanaoipata.
sw.R: Lakini lango na njia vinavyoelekea kwenye uzima ni vyembamba na vigumu. Ni watu wachache tu wanaovipata.

vi.L: vì cửa hẹp và đường chật dẫn đến sự sống, và có ít người tìm được.
vi.B: Còn cửa dẫn đến sự sống thì hẹp và đường thì khó đi, và chỉ có ít người tìm được.
vi.R: Nhưng cửa và con đường dẫn đến sự sống thì hẹp và khó đi. Chỉ có ít người tìm được.

ko.L: 생명으로 데려가는 문은 좁고 그 길은 비좁아서, 그것을 찾는 사람들이 적기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그러나 생명으로 가는 문은 좁고 그 길은 험해서, 그 길을 찾는 사람이 적다.
ko.R: 그러나 생명으로 가는 문과 길은 좁고 험하다. 그 길을 찾는 사람은 얼마 되지 않는다.

decisions.choice: hard: narrow, pressed in, a road of trouble
decisions.reason: The word comes from the verb for pressing or afflicting. The way of the disciple includes hardship and persecution (5:10-12).

decisions.choice: life: the life of the age to come
decisions.reason: Life here is entering the kingdom (19:16-17, 29; 25:46).

decisions.choice: apretado
decisions.reason: The Greek word means pressed in, hemmed in by trouble (meaning decision m1), not only narrow. "Apretado" keeps the picture of pressure; Balanced and Readable say "difícil", as the English says "hard".

decisions.choice: yenye dhiki (pressed, troubled)
decisions.reason: The Greek word means pressed in, hemmed in by trouble (meaning decision m1), not only narrow. Literal keeps that picture with "dhiki"; Balanced and Readable say "ngumu" (hard), as the English does.

source.text: Προσέχετε ἀπὸ τῶν ψευδοπροφητῶν, οἵτινες ἔρχονται πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἐν ἐνδύμασι προβάτων ἔσωθεν δέ εἰσιν λύκοι ἅρπαγες.

records.literal_gloss: Beware of the false prophets, who come to you in clothing of sheep inwardly but are wolves ravenous.

en.L: Beware of the false prophets, who come to you in sheep's clothing but inwardly are ravenous wolves.
en.B: Watch out for false prophets. They come to you looking like sheep, but underneath they are hungry wolves.
en.R: Watch out for people who say they speak for God but do not. They come to you looking gentle like sheep, but inside they are like hungry wolves.

es.L: {{plural_you:Tengan|Tened}} cuidado con los falsos profetas, los cuales se {{plural_you:les|os}} acercan con ropa de ovejas, pero por dentro son lobos voraces.
es.B: {{plural_you:Cuídense|Cuidaos}} de los falsos profetas. Vienen a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} con apariencia de ovejas, pero por debajo son lobos hambrientos.
es.R: {{plural_you:Cuídense|Cuidaos}} de los que dicen que hablan de parte de Dios, pero no es así. Vienen a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} con aspecto manso, como ovejas, pero por dentro son como lobos hambrientos.

fr.L: Gardez-vous des faux prophètes, qui viennent à vous en vêtements de brebis, mais au-dedans ce sont des loups voraces.
fr.B: Méfiez-vous des faux prophètes. Ils viennent à vous avec l’apparence de brebis, mais au fond ce sont des loups affamés.
fr.R: Faites attention aux gens qui disent qu’ils parlent de la part de Dieu, mais qui ne le font pas. Ils viennent vers vous doux comme des moutons, mais à l’intérieur ils sont comme des loups affamés.

sw.L: Jilindeni dhidi ya manabii wa uongo, ambao wanakuja kwenu katika mavazi ya kondoo, lakini kwa ndani ni mbwa mwitu wanyang'anyi.
sw.B: Kaeni macho na manabii wa uongo. Wanakuja kwenu wakionekana kama kondoo, lakini ndani yao ni mbwa mwitu wenye njaa.
sw.R: Kaeni macho na watu wanaodai kwamba wanasema kwa niaba ya Mungu, lakini sivyo. Wanakuja kwenu wakionekana wapole kama kondoo, lakini ndani yao ni kama mbwa mwitu wenye njaa.

vi.L: Hãy coi chừng các tiên tri giả, là những kẻ đến với các con trong lớp áo chiên, nhưng bên trong là lang sói hung dữ.
vi.B: Hãy đề phòng các tiên tri giả. Họ đến với các con trông như chiên, nhưng bên trong là những con sói đói mồi.
vi.R: Hãy đề phòng những người tự xưng là nói thay Đức Chúa Trời nhưng không phải vậy. Họ đến với các con trông hiền lành như chiên, nhưng bên trong họ giống như những con sói đói.

ko.L: 거짓 예언자들을 조심하여라. 그들은 양의 옷을 입고 너희에게 오지만, 속은 사나운 이리들이다.
ko.B: 거짓 예언자들을 경계하여라. 그들은 양처럼 보이는 모습으로 너희에게 오지만, 속은 굶주린 이리들이다.
ko.R: 하나님의 말씀을 전한다고 하지만 사실은 그렇지 않은 사람들을 조심하여라. 그들은 양처럼 순한 모습으로 너희에게 온다. 그러나 속은 굶주린 늑대와 같다.

decisions.choice: false prophets: those who claim to speak for God but lead people astray
decisions.reason: Israel had long been warned against them (Deuteronomy 13:1-5; Jeremiah 23:16). Jesus warns of them again in 24:11, 24.

decisions.choice: sheep's clothing, wolves: harmless outside, dangerous within
decisions.reason: The flock is God's people; the wolves look like members of it but prey on it.

decisions.choice: people who say they speak for God but do not
decisions.reason: Readable says what a false prophet is.

decisions.choice: "tiên tri giả" (L, B); "những người tự xưng là nói thay Đức Chúa Trời" (R)
decisions.reason: Readable explains the term as the English Readable does; "chiên" is the Bible word for sheep, as in John 10.

decisions.choice: "거짓 예언자" (L, B), explained (R); "이리" (L, B), "늑대" (R)
decisions.reason: "예언자" as in 7:12; Readable says who they are, as the English Readable does. "이리" is the word of the familiar sayings about sheep and wolves; Readable uses the everyday "늑대".

source.text: ἀπὸ τῶν καρπῶν αὐτῶν ἐπιγνώσεσθε αὐτούς.

records.literal_gloss: By the fruits of them you will know them.

en.L: By their fruits you will recognize them.
en.B: You will know them by what their lives produce.
en.R: You will know who they are by what they do.

es.L: Por sus frutos los {{plural_you:reconocerán|reconoceréis}}.
es.B: Los {{plural_you:conocerán|conoceréis}} por lo que sus vidas producen.
es.R: {{plural_you:Sabrán|Sabréis}} quiénes son por lo que hacen.

fr.L: À leurs fruits vous les reconnaîtrez.
fr.B: Vous les reconnaîtrez à ce que produit leur vie.
fr.R: Vous saurez qui ils sont en regardant ce qu’ils font.

sw.L: Kwa matunda yao mtawatambua.
sw.B: Mtawajua kwa yale ambayo maisha yao huzaa.
sw.R: Mtajua wao ni watu wa aina gani kwa yale wanayoyatenda.

vi.L: Nhờ trái của họ, các con sẽ nhận ra họ.
vi.B: Các con sẽ nhận biết họ qua những gì đời sống họ sinh ra.
vi.R: Các con sẽ biết họ là ai qua những việc họ làm.

ko.L: 그들의 열매들로 너희가 그들을 알아볼 것이다.
ko.B: 너희는 그들의 삶이 맺는 열매를 보고 그들을 알아볼 것이다.
ko.R: 그들이 하는 일을 보면 그들이 어떤 사람인지 알 수 있다.

decisions.choice: fruits: what a person's life produces, in deeds and in teaching
decisions.reason: As in 3:8 and 12:33, fruit is the outcome of a life. False prophets show what they are by how they live and by what their teaching produces.

decisions.choice: "trái" (L); "những gì đời sống họ sinh ra" (B); "những việc họ làm" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision explains the fruit as what a life produces in deeds and teaching. Literal keeps the picture; Balanced and Readable say what it means, as the English does. Also in 7:20.

source.text: μήτι συλλέγουσιν ἀπὸ ἀκανθῶν σταφυλὰς ἢ ἀπὸ τριβόλων σῦκα;

records.literal_gloss: Not do they gather from thorns grapes or from thistles figs?

en.L: Do they gather grapes from thorns, or figs from thistles?
en.B: Do people pick grapes from thornbushes, or figs from thistles?
en.R: People do not pick grapes from thornbushes or figs from weeds.

es.L: ¿Acaso recogen de los espinos uvas, o de los cardos higos?
es.B: ¿Se cosechan uvas de las zarzas, o higos de los cardos?
es.R: La gente no saca uvas de las zarzas ni higos de la mala hierba.

fr.L: Cueille-t-on des raisins sur des épines, ou des figues sur des chardons ?
fr.B: Ramasse-t-on du raisin sur des buissons d’épines, ou des figues sur des chardons ?
fr.R: On ne cueille pas de raisin sur des buissons d’épines, ni de figues sur des mauvaises herbes.

sw.L: Je, watu huvuna zabibu kutoka kwenye miiba, au tini kutoka kwenye mibaruti?
sw.B: Je, watu huchuma zabibu kwenye vichaka vya miiba, au tini kwenye mibaruti?
sw.R: Watu hawachumi zabibu kwenye miiba, wala tini kwenye magugu.

vi.L: Người ta có hái nho từ bụi gai, hay hái vả từ cây tật lê không?
vi.B: Có ai hái được nho từ bụi gai, hay hái được trái vả từ cây tật lê không?
vi.R: Người ta không hái nho từ bụi gai hay hái trái vả từ cỏ dại.

ko.L: 가시나무에서 포도를, 엉겅퀴에서 무화과를 따겠느냐?
ko.B: 가시덤불에서 포도를 따거나 엉겅퀴에서 무화과를 따는 사람이 있느냐?
ko.R: 가시덤불에서 포도를 딸 수 없고, 잡초에서 무화과를 딸 수 없다.

decisions.choice: a question expecting the answer no
decisions.reason: The Greek form expects "no". Readable states the answer.

source.text: οὕτως πᾶν δένδρον ἀγαθὸν καρποὺς καλοὺς ποιεῖ, τὸ δὲ σαπρὸν δένδρον καρποὺς πονηροὺς ποιεῖ·

records.literal_gloss: So every tree good fruits good produces, the but bad tree fruits bad produces;

en.L: So every good tree produces good fruit, but the bad tree produces bad fruit.
en.B: In the same way, every healthy tree bears good fruit, and a diseased tree bears bad fruit.
en.R: In the same way, every good tree grows good fruit, and every bad tree grows bad fruit.

es.L: Así, todo árbol bueno produce frutos buenos, mas el árbol podrido produce frutos malos.
es.B: Del mismo modo, todo árbol sano da buen fruto, y el árbol enfermo da fruto malo.
es.R: De la misma manera, todo árbol bueno da fruta buena, y todo árbol malo da fruta mala.

fr.L: Ainsi, tout bon arbre produit de bons fruits, mais l’arbre mauvais produit de mauvais fruits.
fr.B: De même, tout arbre sain donne de bons fruits, et un arbre malade donne de mauvais fruits.
fr.R: De la même façon, chaque bon arbre fait pousser de bons fruits, et chaque mauvais arbre fait pousser de mauvais fruits.

sw.L: Hivyo kila mti mzuri huzaa matunda mazuri, lakini mti ulioharibika huzaa matunda mabaya.
sw.B: Vivyo hivyo, kila mti wenye afya huzaa matunda mazuri, na mti wenye ugonjwa huzaa matunda mabaya.
sw.R: Vivyo hivyo, kila mti mzuri huzaa matunda mazuri, na kila mti mbaya huzaa matunda mabaya.

vi.L: Vậy mọi cây tốt đều sinh trái tốt, còn cây xấu thì sinh trái xấu;
vi.B: Cũng vậy, cây lành thì sinh trái tốt, còn cây bệnh thì sinh trái xấu.
vi.R: Cũng vậy, cây tốt thì sinh ra trái tốt, cây xấu thì sinh ra trái xấu.

ko.L: 이와 같이 좋은 나무는 모두 좋은 열매들을 맺고, 나쁜 나무는 나쁜 열매들을 맺는다.
ko.B: 이처럼 건강한 나무는 모두 좋은 열매를 맺고, 병든 나무는 나쁜 열매를 맺는다.
ko.R: 이와 마찬가지로, 좋은 나무는 모두 좋은 열매를 맺고, 나쁜 나무는 나쁜 열매를 맺는다.

decisions.choice: bad: rotten, diseased, worthless
decisions.reason: The word is used of rotten things. The tree's nature shows in its fruit.

decisions.choice: healthy, diseased
decisions.reason: Balanced uses words for trees.

decisions.choice: podrido
decisions.reason: The Greek word for the bad tree means rotten, diseased (meaning decision m1). Literal says "podrido" so the reader sees it is a different word from the "malos" of the fruit; Balanced says "enfermo", as the English says "diseased". The same in verse 18.

decisions.choice: "cây lành" and "cây bệnh" (B)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision gives "rotten, diseased" for the word; Balanced speaks of the tree's health, as the English Balanced does.

source.text: οὐ δύναται δένδρον ἀγαθὸν καρποὺς πονηροὺς ποιεῖν, οὐδὲ δένδρον σαπρὸν καρποὺς καλοὺς ποιεῖν.

records.literal_gloss: Not is able a tree good fruits bad to produce, nor a tree bad fruits good to produce.

en.L: A good tree cannot produce bad fruit, nor can a bad tree produce good fruit.
en.B: A healthy tree cannot bear bad fruit, and a diseased tree cannot bear good fruit.
en.R: A good tree cannot grow bad fruit, and a bad tree cannot grow good fruit.

es.L: No puede un árbol bueno producir frutos malos, ni un árbol podrido producir frutos buenos.
es.B: Un árbol sano no puede dar fruto malo, y un árbol enfermo no puede dar fruto bueno.
es.R: Un árbol bueno no puede dar fruta mala, y un árbol malo no puede dar fruta buena.

fr.L: Un bon arbre ne peut pas produire de mauvais fruits, ni un arbre mauvais produire de bons fruits.
fr.B: Un arbre sain ne peut pas donner de mauvais fruits, et un arbre malade ne peut pas donner de bons fruits.
fr.R: Un bon arbre ne peut pas faire pousser de mauvais fruits, et un mauvais arbre ne peut pas faire pousser de bons fruits.

sw.L: Hauwezi mti mzuri kuzaa matunda mabaya, wala mti ulioharibika kuzaa matunda mazuri.
sw.B: Mti wenye afya hauwezi kuzaa matunda mabaya, na mti wenye ugonjwa hauwezi kuzaa matunda mazuri.
sw.R: Mti mzuri hauwezi kuzaa matunda mabaya, na mti mbaya hauwezi kuzaa matunda mazuri.

vi.L: Cây tốt không thể sinh trái xấu, cây xấu cũng không thể sinh trái tốt.
vi.B: Cây lành không thể sinh trái xấu, và cây bệnh cũng không thể sinh trái tốt.
vi.R: Cây tốt không thể sinh ra trái xấu, và cây xấu không thể sinh ra trái tốt.

ko.L: 좋은 나무가 나쁜 열매들을 맺을 수 없고, 나쁜 나무가 좋은 열매들을 맺을 수도 없다.
ko.B: 건강한 나무가 나쁜 열매를 맺을 수 없고, 병든 나무가 좋은 열매를 맺을 수도 없다.
ko.R: 좋은 나무는 나쁜 열매를 맺을 수 없고, 나쁜 나무는 좋은 열매를 맺을 수 없다.

decisions.choice: cannot: what a person is will show in what they do
decisions.reason: The saying is about recognizing what is there. Jesus elsewhere calls for a tree to be made good (12:33).

source.text: πᾶν δένδρον μὴ ποιοῦν καρπὸν καλὸν ἐκκόπτεται καὶ εἰς πῦρ βάλλεται.

records.literal_gloss: Every tree not producing fruit good is cut down and into fire is thrown.

en.L: Every tree not producing good fruit is cut down and thrown into [the] fire.
en.B: Any tree that fails to bear good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.
en.R: Every tree that does not grow good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire.

es.L: Todo árbol que no produce fruto bueno se corta y se arroja al fuego.
es.B: Todo árbol que no da buen fruto se corta y se echa al fuego.
es.R: Todo árbol que no da fruta buena será cortado y echado al fuego.

fr.L: Tout arbre qui ne produit pas de bon fruit est coupé et jeté au feu.
fr.B: Tout arbre qui ne donne pas de bon fruit est abattu et jeté au feu.
fr.R: Chaque arbre qui ne fait pas pousser de bons fruits sera coupé et jeté au feu.

sw.L: Kila mti usiozaa tunda zuri unakatwa na kutupwa katika moto.
sw.B: Mti wowote usiozaa matunda mazuri hukatwa, ukatupwa motoni.
sw.R: Kila mti usiozaa matunda mazuri utakatwa na kutupwa motoni.

vi.L: Hễ cây nào không sinh trái tốt thì bị chặt và ném vào lửa.
vi.B: Cây nào không sinh trái tốt đều bị chặt xuống và ném vào lửa.
vi.R: Cây nào không sinh ra trái tốt sẽ bị chặt bỏ và ném vào lửa.

ko.L: 좋은 열매를 맺지 않는 나무는 모두 찍혀서 불에 던져진다.
ko.B: 좋은 열매를 맺지 못하는 나무는 모두 찍혀서 불 속에 던져진다.
ko.R: 좋은 열매를 맺지 않는 나무는 모두 베어져 불에 던져질 것이다.

decisions.choice: the words of John the Baptist (3:10)
decisions.reason: Jesus repeats John's warning word for word. The levels repeat the wording they used at 3:10.

source.text: ἄρα γε ἀπὸ τῶν καρπῶν αὐτῶν ἐπιγνώσεσθε αὐτούς.

records.literal_gloss: So then by the fruits of them you will know them.

en.L: So then, by their fruits you will recognize them.
en.B: So you will know them by what their lives produce.
en.R: So you will know who they are by what they do.

es.L: Así pues, por sus frutos los {{plural_you:reconocerán|reconoceréis}}.
es.B: Así que los {{plural_you:conocerán|conoceréis}} por lo que sus vidas producen.
es.R: Así {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} quiénes son por lo que hacen.

fr.L: C’est donc à leurs fruits que vous les reconnaîtrez.
fr.B: Ainsi, vous les reconnaîtrez à ce que produit leur vie.
fr.R: Alors, vous saurez qui ils sont en regardant ce qu’ils font.

sw.L: Basi, kwa matunda yao mtawatambua.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo mtawajua kwa yale ambayo maisha yao huzaa.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo mtajua wao ni watu wa aina gani kwa yale wanayoyatenda.

vi.L: Như vậy, nhờ trái của họ, các con sẽ nhận ra họ.
vi.B: Vậy, các con sẽ nhận biết họ qua những gì đời sống họ sinh ra.
vi.R: Vậy, các con sẽ biết họ là ai qua những việc họ làm.

ko.L: 그러므로 그들의 열매들로 너희가 그들을 알아볼 것이다.
ko.B: 그러므로 너희는 그들의 삶이 맺는 열매를 보고 그들을 알아볼 것이다.
ko.R: 그러니 그들이 하는 일을 보면 그들이 어떤 사람인지 알 수 있다.

decisions.choice: fruits: what a person's life produces, in deeds and in teaching
decisions.reason: As in 3:8 and 12:33, fruit is the outcome of a life. False prophets show what they are by how they live and by what their teaching produces.

decisions.choice: the saying of 7:16 repeated, closing the section
decisions.reason: The repetition frames 7:16-20.

source.text: Οὐ πᾶς ὁ λέγων μοι· Κύριε κύριε εἰσελεύσεται εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τῶν οὐρανῶν, ἀλλ’ ὁ ποιῶν τὸ θέλημα τοῦ πατρός μου τοῦ ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς.

records.literal_gloss: Not everyone the saying to me, Lord, Lord, will enter into the kingdom of the heavens, but the doing the will of the Father of me the in the heavens.

en.L: Not everyone who says to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, 'Lord, Lord,' will enter the kingdom of the heavens, but the one who does the will of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Father who [is] in the heavens.
en.B: Not everyone who calls {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} 'Lord, Lord' will enter the kingdom of heaven, but only those who do what {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Father in heaven wants.
en.R: Not everyone who calls {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} 'Lord' will enter the kingdom of heaven. Only those who do what {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Father in heaven wants will enter.

es.L: No todo el que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} dice “Señor, Señor” entrará en el reino de los cielos, sino quien hace la voluntad de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Padre, el que [está] en los cielos.
es.B: No todo el que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} llama “Señor, Señor” entrará en el reino de los cielos, sino solo quienes hacen lo que quiere {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Padre que está en el cielo.
es.R: No todo el que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} llama “Señor” entrará en el reino de los cielos. Solo entrarán los que hacen lo que quiere {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Padre que está en el cielo.

fr.L: Ce n’est pas quiconque {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} dit : “Seigneur, Seigneur” qui entrera dans le royaume des cieux, mais celui qui fait la volonté de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Père qui [est] dans les cieux.
fr.B: Ce ne sont pas tous ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}appellent “Seigneur, Seigneur” qui entreront dans le royaume des cieux, mais seulement ceux qui font ce que veut {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Père qui est au ciel.
fr.R: Tous ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}appellent “Seigneur” n’entreront pas dans le royaume des cieux. Seuls ceux qui font ce que {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Père qui est au ciel veut y entreront.

sw.L: Si kila anayeniambia, 'Bwana, Bwana,' ataingia katika ufalme wa mbinguni, bali yule anayetenda mapenzi ya Baba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} aliye mbinguni.
sw.B: Si kila mtu anayeniita 'Bwana, Bwana' ataingia katika ufalme wa mbinguni, ila wale tu wanaofanya yale ambayo Baba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} wa mbinguni anataka.
sw.R: Si kila mtu anayeniita 'Bwana' ataingia katika ufalme wa mbinguni. Wataingia wale tu wanaofanya yale ambayo Baba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} wa mbinguni anataka.

vi.L: Không phải hễ ai nói với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}: 'Lạy Chúa, lạy Chúa,' thì sẽ được vào vương quốc thiên đàng, nhưng [chỉ] người làm theo ý muốn của Cha {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, Đấng ở trên các tầng trời.
vi.B: Không phải hễ ai gọi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là 'Lạy Chúa, lạy Chúa' thì đều được vào vương quốc thiên đàng, mà chỉ những người làm theo ý muốn của Cha {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ở trên trời.
vi.R: Không phải ai gọi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là 'Chúa' cũng sẽ được vào vương quốc thiên đàng. Chỉ những người làm theo ý muốn của Cha {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ở trên trời mới được vào.

ko.L: 나에게 '주님, 주님' 하고 말하는 사람이 다 천국에 들어갈 것이 아니라, 하늘에 계신 내 아버지의 뜻을 행하는 사람이 [들어갈 것이다].
ko.B: 나를 '주님, 주님' 하고 부르는 사람이 모두 천국에 들어가는 것은 아니다. 하늘에 계신 내 아버지의 뜻대로 행하는 사람만이 들어간다.
ko.R: 나를 '주님' 하고 부른다고 해서 모두 천국에 들어가는 것은 아니다. 하늘에 계신 내 아버지께서 원하시는 일을 하는 사람만 들어갈 것이다.

decisions.choice: Lord, Lord: calling Jesus master and lord with eager devotion
decisions.reason: The doubled word expresses earnestness. Calling Jesus Lord is not enough without doing God's will.

decisions.choice: the will of my Father: what God requires, as the sermon has set it out
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks of God as "my Father" and makes himself the one whose words reveal that will (7:24).

decisions.choice: Lord
decisions.reason: Readable keeps one "Lord"; the doubling is a form of emphasis that the meaning note explains.

decisions.choice: el reino de los cielos (every level)
decisions.reason: The book-wide term for Matthew's phrase: Spanish keeps the plural "cielos", which is long established, at every level, while "Padre que está en el cielo" uses the everyday singular at Balanced and Readable, as the English does.

decisions.choice: le royaume des cieux at every level (for the whole chapter); "dans les cieux" (L), "au ciel" (B, R) for where the Father is
decisions.reason: The term sheet keeps Matthew's phrase at every level, as the English keeps "kingdom of heaven" at Readable. For the Father's place Balanced and Readable say "au ciel", as the English says "in heaven"; Literal keeps the plural.

decisions.choice: ufalme wa mbinguni (every level)
decisions.reason: The book-wide term for Matthew's phrase. "Mbinguni" serves for the Greek plural "heavens", since Swahili does not count heaven, and Matthew's own wording is kept rather than changed to "kingdom of God".

decisions.choice: "vương quốc thiên đàng" for "the kingdom of the heavens"
alternatives: vương quốc của các tầng trời (L)
decisions.reason: Matthew's form of "the kingdom of God". "vương quốc" follows Mark ("vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời"), and "thiên đàng" (heaven) is the word Protestant readers know from "nước thiên đàng"; the plural of the Greek is left unmarked, as in Vietnamese "trời" has no number.

decisions.choice: "Lạy Chúa" in the address; "Ta" for "me" and "Cha Ta" for "my Father"
decisions.reason: The speakers call Jesus Lord with devotion (meaning decision), so they use the style guide's "Lạy Chúa". Jesus speaks of himself as "Ta", with the setting span.

decisions.choice: "천국" at every level, through Matthew
decisions.reason: Matthew's own phrase for the kingdom of God ("the kingdom of the heavens") is kept rather than changed to Mark's "하나님의 나라". "천국" (the heavens' kingdom) is the established Korean term for it and is used at every level, as settled for the Korean of Matthew; it means God's reign, not only the place the dead go. Korean does not mark the Greek plural "heavens", so Literal needs no other form.

decisions.choice: "주님" for kyrie at every level
decisions.reason: The address is respectful and in Matthew more than that (meaning decision); here the speakers claim Jesus as their Lord at the judgment, so "주님" is the only fit, as in 7:22.

source.text: πολλοὶ ἐροῦσίν μοι ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ· Κύριε κύριε, οὐ τῷ σῷ ὀνόματι ἐπροφητεύσαμεν, καὶ τῷ σῷ ὀνόματι δαιμόνια ἐξεβάλομεν, καὶ τῷ σῷ ὀνόματι δυνάμεις πολλὰς ἐποιήσαμεν;

records.literal_gloss: Many will say to me in that the day, Lord, Lord, not in your name we prophesied, and in your name demons cast out, and in your name mighty works many did?

en.L: Many will say to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} on that day, 'Lord, Lord, did we not prophesy in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name, and in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name cast out demons, and in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name do many mighty works?'
en.B: On that day many will say to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, 'Lord, Lord, did we not prophesy in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name, drive out demons in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name, and do many miracles in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name?'
en.R: On judgment day many people will say to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, 'Lord, Lord, we spoke for God in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name. We forced demons out of people in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name, and we did many miracles in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name.'

es.L: Muchos {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} dirán en ese día: “Señor, Señor, ¿no profetizamos en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre, y en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre expulsamos demonios, y en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre hicimos muchas obras poderosas?”.
es.B: Aquel día muchos {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} dirán: “Señor, Señor, ¿acaso no profetizamos en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre, no expulsamos demonios en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre y no hicimos muchos milagros en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre?”.
es.R: El día del juicio mucha gente {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} dirá: “Señor, Señor, nosotros hablamos de parte de Dios en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre. Echamos demonios fuera de la gente en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre, e hicimos muchos milagros en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre”.

fr.L: Beaucoup {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} diront en ce jour-là : “Seigneur, Seigneur, n’est-ce pas en {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom que nous avons prophétisé, et en {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom que nous avons chassé des démons, et en {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom que nous avons fait beaucoup d’actes de puissance ?”
fr.B: Ce jour-là, beaucoup {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} diront : “Seigneur, Seigneur, n’avons-nous pas prophétisé en {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom ? N’avons-nous pas chassé des démons en {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom, et fait beaucoup de miracles en {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom ?”
fr.R: Le jour du jugement, beaucoup de gens {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} diront : “Seigneur, Seigneur, nous avons parlé de la part de Dieu en {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom. Nous avons obligé des démons à sortir des gens en {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom, et nous avons fait beaucoup de miracles en {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom.”

sw.L: Wengi wataniambia katika siku hiyo, 'Bwana, Bwana, je, hatukutabiri kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}, na kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} tukatoa pepo, na kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} tukafanya matendo mengi ya nguvu?'
sw.B: Siku hiyo wengi wataniambia, 'Bwana, Bwana, je, hatukutoa unabii kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}, tukafukuza pepo kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}, na kufanya miujiza mingi kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}?'
sw.R: Siku ya hukumu watu wengi wataniambia, 'Bwana, Bwana, tulisema ujumbe wa Mungu kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}. Tuliwafukuza pepo kutoka kwa watu kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}, na tulifanya miujiza mingi kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}.'

vi.L: Trong ngày ấy, nhiều người sẽ nói với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}: 'Lạy Chúa, lạy Chúa, chẳng phải chúng con đã nhân danh Chúa mà nói tiên tri, nhân danh Chúa mà đuổi quỷ, và nhân danh Chúa mà làm nhiều việc quyền năng sao?'
vi.B: Trong ngày ấy, nhiều người sẽ nói với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}: 'Lạy Chúa, lạy Chúa, chẳng phải chúng con đã nhân danh Chúa mà nói tiên tri, nhân danh Chúa mà đuổi quỷ, và nhân danh Chúa mà làm nhiều phép lạ sao?'
vi.R: Vào ngày phán xét, nhiều người sẽ nói với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}: 'Lạy Chúa, lạy Chúa, chúng con đã nhân danh Chúa mà nói thay cho Đức Chúa Trời. Chúng con đã nhân danh Chúa mà đuổi quỷ ra khỏi người ta, và đã nhân danh Chúa mà làm nhiều phép lạ.'

ko.L: 그날에 많은 사람이 나에게 말할 것이다. '주님, 주님, 저희가 주님의 이름으로 예언하고, 주님의 이름으로 귀신들을 쫓아내고, 주님의 이름으로 많은 능력 있는 일들을 행하지 않았습니까?'
ko.B: 그날에 많은 사람이 나에게 말할 것이다. '주님, 주님, 저희가 주님의 이름으로 예언하고, 주님의 이름으로 귀신을 쫓아내고, 주님의 이름으로 많은 기적을 행하지 않았습니까?'
ko.R: 심판의 날에 많은 사람이 나에게 이렇게 말할 것이다. '주님, 주님, 저희는 주님의 이름으로 하나님의 말씀을 전했습니다. 주님의 이름으로 귀신들을 쫓아냈고, 주님의 이름으로 놀라운 일도 많이 했습니다.'

decisions.choice: that day: the day of judgment
alternatives: a day in the near future
decisions.reason: The prophets spoke of "that day" as the day the Lord would judge (Isaiah 2:11; Zechariah 14:4). Jesus himself is the judge (25:31-46).

decisions.choice: deeds done in his name: even real works of power do not prove a person is his
decisions.reason: Jesus does not say the deeds were fake. Gifts and powers are not the same as knowing him and doing God's will.

decisions.choice: statements instead of a question
decisions.reason: Readable states what the question claims.

decisions.choice: your name, with deity_pronoun spans
decisions.reason: The speakers address Jesus, so "your" takes the usual span.

decisions.choice: chasser des démons (L, B), obliger des démons à sortir des gens (R); actes de puissance (L), miracles (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Un démon" is the term sheet's word. Readable says what driving out a demon is, as in the French of Mark 1:34. Literal keeps the Greek "powers" as "actes de puissance"; Balanced and Readable use the common word, as the English does. The speakers say "tu" to Jesus, so "ton nom" takes the span.

decisions.choice: "danh Chúa" for "your name", with no deity_pronoun span; "chúng con" for "we"
decisions.reason: Those who call Jesus Lord speak to him as "Chúa", a noun of address that takes no setting span (style guide, section 6), and of themselves as "chúng con".

decisions.choice: the speakers address Jesus in 합쇼체 with "저희" and "주님의 이름"
decisions.reason: People speaking to Jesus use 합쇼체 and the humble "저희" for themselves, and Korean repeats "주님" where the English has "your", since a pronoun for him would be impolite.

decisions.choice: "능력 있는 일" (L); "기적" (B); "놀라운 일" (R)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 9:39.

source.text: καὶ τότε ὁμολογήσω αὐτοῖς ὅτι Οὐδέποτε ἔγνων ὑμᾶς· ἀποχωρεῖτε ἀπ’ ἐμοῦ οἱ ἐργαζόμενοι τὴν ἀνομίαν.
